bill.officialSummary: Agriculture, Rural Development, Food and Drug Administration, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2026 This bill provides FY2026 appropriations for the Department of Agriculture (USDA), the Food and Drug Administration, and related agencies. The bill provides appropriations to USDA for agricultural programs, including the Office of the Secretary, Executive Operations, the Economic Research Service, the National Agricultural Statistics Service, the Agricultural Research Service, the National Institute of Food and Agriculture, the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service, the Agricultural Marketing Service, and the Food Safety and Inspection Service. The bill also provides appropriations to USDA for farm production and conservation programs, including the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, the Farm Service Agency, the Risk Management Agency, and the Natural Resources Conservation Service. The bill provides appropriations to the Federal Crop Insurance Corporation Fund and the Commodity Credit Corporation Fund. For USDA rural development programs, the bill includes appropriations for Salaries and Expenses, the Rural Housing Service, the Rural Business-Cooperative Service, and the Rural Utilities Service. The bill provides appropriations to the Food and Nutrition Service for Child Nutrition Programs; the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC); the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP); the Commodity Assistance Program; and Nutrition Programs Administration. The bill provides appropriations to the Foreign Agricultural Service for (1) Food for Peace Title II Grants, and (2) McGovern-Dole International Food for Education and Child Nutrition Program Grants. The bill also provides appropriations for the Food and Drug Administration, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, and the Farm Credit Administration. Additionally, the bill sets forth requirements and restrictions for using funds provided by this and other appropriations acts.

classification.plainSummary: This bill sets funding levels for the Department of Agriculture, the Food and Drug Administration, and related agencies for fiscal year 2026. It allocates money for farm programs, rural development, nutrition assistance (including SNAP and WIC), food safety inspection, agricultural research, crop insurance, and international food aid. The bill also funds the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and sets rules on how these agencies may spend the appropriated funds.

industries.rationale: The bill directly funds USDA programs including farm subsidies, crop insurance, conservation, research, marketing, and inspection services that shape the sector's operating environment.
The bill appropriates funds for the Food and Drug Administration, which regulates drug safety and medical devices, directly affecting compliance costs and approval timelines.
The bill funds the Federal Crop Insurance Corporation and the Risk Management Agency, which administer agricultural insurance programs.
The bill provides appropriations for the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, which regulates commodities and derivatives markets, and the Farm Credit Administration.
The bill funds the Rural Utilities Service, which provides financing and support for rural electric power generation and transmission infrastructure.

plain.whatItDoes: This bill would provide 2026 appropriations for the USDA, the FDA, and related agencies.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
